OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Dear BYDFi Users,
Unlock extra rewards this year-end! Complete an eligible first crypto purchase to receive 3% cashback and a 100 USDT BTC Airdrop Position. Reach cumulative purchase targets during the event to unlock up to 1,000 USDT in additional BTC Airdrop Positions. Rewards from both offers can be combined!
📅 Event Period: 2026/11/26 20:00 – 2026/12/16 20:00（UTC+8）
👉 Join Now
🎁 Offer 1: First Crypto Purchase, Double Rewards
Make your first successful crypto purchase of over 50 USDT to receive:
A 100 USDT BTC Airdrop Position
3% cashback: Calculated based on your first successful purchase order, capped at 200 USDT and paid in USDT.
Both rewards can be claimed together. This offer has a 50,000 USDT prize pool, available on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last!
🪙 Offer 2: Buy More Crypto, Unlock Tiered Rewards
Open to all users! Reach the following cumulative crypto purchase targets during the event to claim the corresponding BTC Airdrop Position rewards:
Cumulative Crypto Purchases | BTC Airdrop Position Rewards
≥ 100 USDT | 100 USDT
≥ 300 USDT | 250 USDT
≥ 500 USDT | 500 USDT
≥ 1,000 USDT | 1,000 USDT
Earn up to 1,100 USDT in BTC Airdrop Positions across both offers, plus 3% cashback on your first crypto purchase!
## Notes:
1. First-purchase rewards apply to your first successful crypto purchase order, which must exceed 50 USDT.
2. Only successful crypto purchases completed during the event count toward cumulative purchase targets.
3. Please refer to the event page for BTC Airdrop Position usage conditions, tier reward claim procedures, and distribution rules.
